source_edits.subject: state the full and PostScript names of the release
source_edits.body: The .vfb and the first release (google/fonts 90abd17b4) name the font Irish Grover and IrishGrover. The release Google Fonts ships, version 1.001 of the 2017 hotfix (google/fonts daa6505c6, "hotfix-irishgrover: v1.001 added (#777)"), names it Irish Grover Regular and IrishGrover-Regular (name IDs 4 and 6). This states those names.
